Subject: BrightPath Health - Demo request & qualification

Hi Marissa (and Ava),

I signed up for a trial yesterday and would love to get a short demo to see if Redwood fits our use case. Quick context: BrightPath Health is building a clinical summarization tool that ingests patient visit notes and generates short triage summaries for clinicians.

Before we lock a slot for a demo, a few high-level questions to help the call be productive:
- Primary use case: automated visit summarization + triage flags (PHI will be present)
- Volume: ~45k documents / month, avg ~750 tokens per document
- Expected concurrency: initial pilot ~5 concurrent reqs, eventual steady state ~25
- Timeline: pilot in Q1 2027, production in Q3 2027
- Compliance: handling PHI — do you offer a BAA / SOC 2 evidence / dedicated instances?

Could you share an available 30-min slot next week? Also would appreciate any pre-read or one-pager on performance/cost for summarization workloads.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Head of Data Platforms, BrightPath Health
alex@brightpathhealth.com

Hi Alex — thanks for the detailed note, and great to e-meet you. I can take the demo and focus on performance and deployment options for PHI workloads. Short answers up front, then a proposed plan for the call:

Answers / considerations:
- Structured vs free-form: both are supported; if you have EHR exports we can demo mapping and field extraction, otherwise we’ll show free-text summarization prompts and quality controls.
- Hosted with BAA: we support BAA-backed hosted environments for pilots. For stricter requirements we offer Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments.
- SOC 2: we can share our SOC 2 Type II report; we also provide audit logs and KMS integrations for key management.
- Latency: for median single-doc summarization on a standard 8k-context model we typically see 80–150ms per 512-token chunk on our Dedicated runtime; end-to-end depends on prompt size and KV-cache behavior.

Questions to make the demo productive:
1) Can you share 1–2 example notes (sanitized or synthetic) so we can prepare prompts and evals?
2) Approx tokens per request (you mentioned ~750 avg — is that total tokens including prompt + response?)
3) Any PII/PHI handling policies we should be aware of (data retention, redaction needs)?

Proposed agenda for 30-min call:
- 0–5 min: intros & goals
- 5–20 min: demo (ingest -> prompt -> summary -> iteration)
- 20–25 min: deployment & compliance options (BAA, Private)
- 25–30 min: next steps / pilot milestones

I attached a one-pager with typical performance/cost tradeoffs for summarization workloads.

Available slots (PT):
- Wed 2026-10-07 14:00–14:30 (saved)
- Thu 2026-10-08 09:30–10:00

If the Wed slot works, I’ll send a calendar invite (we use Zoom).

Thanks,
Ava Chen

Hi Ava / Marissa — thanks, Wed 2026-10-07 14:00 PT works for us. Confirming a couple of notes so you can prep:

- Documents: mostly free-form clinician notes exported as text (we can provide 2–3 redacted examples prior to the call).
- Tokens: ~750 tokens covers prompt + expected ~150 token summary response — so request size will be ~900 tokens in total per call (approx).
- Concurrency: pilot will run ~5 concurrent requests; target production ~20–25 concurrent.
- Latency SLO: ideally <500ms p95 for a single summary (we can tolerate higher if batching helps cost).
- Compliance: PHI — we will need a BAA for hosted pilot. For production we may require Private (VPC) depending on legal review.
- Pricing ask: can you share a pilot ballpark (monthly estimate) for 45k documents at the token counts above? A back-of-envelope will help procurement.

I’ve attached a short infra diagram to show our current ingestion pipeline (sanitized). Looking forward to the demo — please send a Zoom invite for Wed 14:00 PT and I’ll add our engineer on.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Data Platforms, BrightPath Health
